exceptions.rationale: Reviewed the v0.43.0 Linux amd64 registry-render local reproduction from rehearsal 39628787124 on 2026-10-21. The pinned distroless cc-debian13 nonroot base, complete ordered DiffIDs, production OCI process contract, native Grype/Syft inventories and assertion file digests were checked against the exact exported rootfs. Grype reports wont-fix with no fixed version for libc6 2.41-12+deb13u4. The carried libc/resolver implementation remains present. The reviewed application executables import and contain none of ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, ns_sprintrrf, ns_sprintrr or fp_nquery, and no reviewed dynamic lookup selects them. The bounded source paths do not enter the affected TSIG diagnostic-printing functions; ordinary resolver initialization does not establish that path. The reviewed reports exposure/registry-render.json record no review-required dynamic lookup in /usr/local/bin/registry-render; their resolved constant lookups select only __pthread_get_minstack, _dl_find_object, getrandom, none of which selects an affected symbol or library. Candidate acceptance still requires the exact ordered rootfs layers, production OCI process contract and Syft-bound executable, loader, libc, libm and libpthread digests. The owner, invalidation triggers, and 2026-11-03 expiry remain unchanged.

Reviewed the v0.43.0 Linux amd64 registry-render local reproduction from rehearsal 39628787124 on 2026-10-21. The pinned distroless cc-debian13 nonroot base, complete ordered DiffIDs, production OCI process contract, native Grype/Syft inventories and assertion file digests were checked against the exact exported rootfs. Grype reports wont-fix with no fixed version for gcc-14-base 14.2.0-19. The carried libstdc++ aligned operator-new implementation calls posix_memalign with the unrounded requested size and imports neither aligned_alloc nor memalign. libgcc_s and libgomp define no aligned operator new; libgomp separately imports memalign for its OpenMP allocator. The reviewed application executables need none of libstdc++, libgcc_s or libgomp, import no C++ symbols and contain no aligned operator-new names. The complete representative base-ELF scan found no libstdc++ or libgomp consumer and only libstdc++ itself needing libgcc_s. Relevant base-library bytes match across all ten exports, and every application executable was checked separately. No reviewed application or dynamic lookup reaches that C++ allocation closure.
